product-01.jpg.zh: 马面裙成衣全身实拍：前后光面与两侧褶裥清晰，可对照明制马面结构。
product-01.jpg.en: Full mamian set shoot: flat panels and side pleats — use to verify Ming-style structure.

product-02.jpg.zh: 马面裙局部细节：观察织纹与褶距是否均匀，判断做工稳定性。
product-02.jpg.en: Mamian detail: check weave and even pleat spacing for construction quality.

product-03.jpg.zh: 马面裙面料特写：提花/织金层次帮助判断工艺成本与耐看度。
product-03.jpg.en: Fabric close-up: jacquard/metallic layers hint at craft cost and durability.

product-04.jpg.zh: 马面裙上身搭配：注意腰头高度与上衣叠穿，避免「头重脚轻」。
product-04.jpg.en: Styled mamian: match waist height with the top so proportions stay balanced.

product-05.jpg.zh: 马面裙侧面轮廓：看开衩与摆动，评估通勤是否方便。
product-05.jpg.en: Side silhouette: slits and swing matter for daily walking comfort.

product-06.jpg.zh: 结构细节参考：下单前应向卖家索要同等清晰的平铺结构图。
product-06.jpg.en: Structure cue: always ask sellers for equally clear flat-lay construction shots.

product-07.jpg.zh: 完整造型参考：裙长、发饰与鞋履要和身高、场合匹配。
product-07.jpg.en: Full look: hem, hairpieces and shoes must match height and occasion.

product-08.jpg.zh: 妆花马面成衣：银线/妆花更吃工时，适合作为中高品质对照样本。
product-08.jpg.en: Zhuanghua mamian: metallic craft costs more time — a mid-premium quality benchmark.

product-09.jpg.zh: 妆花纹样特写：看针法密度与左右对称，避免糊片印花冒充。
product-09.jpg.en: Motif close-up: stitch density and symmetry expose cheap print fakes.

product-10.jpg.zh: 妆花马面腰部：光面宽度与褶量是形制是否「像」的关键。
product-10.jpg.en: Waist structure: panel width and pleat volume decide silhouette accuracy.

product-11.jpg.zh: 妆花马面上身：正式感强，适合礼仪、节令出片场景。
product-11.jpg.en: Worn zhuanghua mamian: stronger formal presence for ceremony photos.

product-12.jpg.zh: 面料光泽对比：真丝与化纤反光不同，描述含糊时以此自查。
product-12.jpg.en: Sheen check: silk vs synthetics reflect differently — verify vague fiber claims.

product-13.jpg.zh: 妆花套装整体：上下装色系统一，比单件堆砌元素更耐看。
product-13.jpg.en: Coordinated set: unified color stories beat random motif stacking.

product-14.jpg.zh: 襦裙向套装上身：上衣与下裙分裁，先确认腰线是齐胸还是齐腰。
product-14.jpg.en: Ruqun-style set: separate top/skirt — confirm chest-high vs waist-high line.

product-15.jpg.zh: 襦裙细节：交领/对襟线索必须在平铺图里核对，单靠摆拍不够。
product-15.jpg.en: Ruqun detail: cross-collar vs center-front must be verified on flat-lays.

product-16.jpg.zh: 粉系襦裙氛围：日常出游常见配色，仍要以结构正确为前提。
product-16.jpg.en: Soft pink ruqun mood: common for outings — structure still comes first.

product-17.jpg.zh: 襦裙上衣特写：袖型与领缘决定气质，袖笼起皱常是版型问题。
product-17.jpg.en: Top close-up: sleeve and collar set the mood; armhole wrinkles signal pattern issues.

product-18.jpg.zh: 下裙层次：检查透色与内衬说明，浅色款尤其关键。
product-18.jpg.en: Skirt layers: check sheerness and lining notes, especially on light colors.

product-19.jpg.zh: 清爽配色襦裙：偏宋风日常可穿，适合通勤向入门。
product-19.jpg.en: Clean palette ruqun: Song-leaning daily wear, good commute starter.

product-20.jpg.zh: 成套效果：披帛与发饰宜克制，先把衣身形制穿对。
product-20.jpg.en: Full set: keep scarves/hairpieces restrained until the base silhouette is correct.

product-21.jpg.zh: 上衣平铺型片：通袖长、衣长应与尺码表厘米数据一致。
product-21.jpg.en: Flat top panel: sleeve span and length must match the cm size chart.

product-22.jpg.zh: 下裙型片：裙长粗算可参考「身高-60cm」，仍以平铺为准。
product-22.jpg.en: Flat skirt panel: hem ≈ height−60cm is only a rough rule — trust flat specs.

product-23.jpg.zh: 浅色上衣型片：看锁边与缝份是否工整，廉价线会起毛。
product-23.jpg.en: Light top panel: neat overlocking beats fuzzy cheap seams.

product-24.jpg.zh: 粉色下裙型片：染色是否均匀、布边是否起毛可由此判断。
product-24.jpg.en: Pink skirt panel: check dye evenness and raw edges.

product-25.jpg.zh: 白色下裙型片：易透色，购买前确认内衬与推荐内搭。
product-25.jpg.en: White skirt panel: sheerness risk — confirm lining and underskirt advice.

product-26.jpg.zh: 齐胸风成衣：高腰线是第一辨识点，勿被滤镜「抬高」误导。
product-26.jpg.en: Chest-high style: high waistband is the tell — don’t trust filter angles alone.

product-27.jpg.zh: 齐胸红款实拍：节令/婚礼配色常见，结构仍需交领与分裁正确。
product-27.jpg.en: Red chest-high set: festive palette — structure must still be correct.

product-28.jpg.zh: 齐胸正面：裙头位置、肩线是否歪斜，上身图与平铺对照看。
product-28.jpg.en: Front chest-high view: compare waistband placement and shoulder line to flat-lays.

product-29.jpg.zh: 齐胸细节：肩袖与裙头连接处最易露馅，也是质检重点。
product-29.jpg.en: Chest-high detail: sleeve-to-waistband junction is a common QC failure point.
